title: 第9章 异界遗迹救人于水火的交友技巧第10章 蛇信村部族仙书有云
content_zh:
“咕嘎！”
颓垣断壁中，陆羽的突然出现，惊起了一片鸦雀。
其中数只双眼猩红的黑鸟，似乎是闻见了陆羽身上的活人气息。
双眼里红光大冒，黑翼一展，就向陆羽扑来。
“不强，可以一战，得小心数量！”
刚一落地，警惕观察四周的陆羽第一时间就发现了向他扑来的红眼黑鸟。
一直运转着静心摄念法的陆羽心中没有胆怯害怕的心思，只有即将战斗的冷静与肾上腺素飙升。
稍稍后退，背靠着断墙，护住背后，陆羽守株待兔，静等红眼黑鸟飞近。
“哗啦！”
扑棱翅膀的声音逼近身前，陆羽手中的赤阳心灯顿时大绽光明。
“吃我一发闪光弹！”
“嗡！”
扑到陆羽身前的红眼黑鸟眼里顿时被白色的光占满，失去视野，红眼黑鸟立刻飞得混乱起来，乱作一团。
好机会！
见此情景，陆羽立刻抓住机会，另一只手中凭空出现一根防暴棍，对着近在身前的红眼黑鸟抽去。
“啪嗒”一声。
这一头有母鸡大小的红眼黑鸟，顿时被抽的血花四溅，嘎嘎乱叫一声，砸在地面上，支棱不起来。
打落一只红眼黑鸟，陆羽得势不饶人，继续攻向其他的红眼黑鸟。
三下五除二，陆羽轻松地拿下四只红眼黑鸟的小命。
见同伴惨死在陆羽的棍下，周围其他的红眼黑鸟立刻惊慌地扑棱着翅膀，飞离这片断垣颓壁。

生怕眼前的这个黑色凶神，再向它们伸出魔爪。
等其他红眼黑鸟散去，陆羽也没有扩大战果，继续追击的想法。
他拿着棍子，对地上的四只红眼黑鸟的尸体戳了戳，碾碎它们的头颅，彻底断绝生机。
完事之后，陆羽才放松下来。
别看陆羽干净利落地解决这四只红眼黑鸟，实际上真正战斗的时候，他也感觉到了不小的压力。
红眼黑鸟仅母鸡大小，但它们的速度和力量比帝国境内翱翔于天际的雄鹰还要强大，隐约都有一些妖兽的力量了。
起码相当于一个练了几年拳脚的武者。
它们从天而降，突然袭击之下，可以轻松伤人性命。
“这就是异界的普通生物吗？这个地方看来有些不凡啊！”
异界的普通鸟都这么厉害，陆羽将心中异界的危险等级提升了一个档次。
陆羽暗暗叮嘱自己，要更加小心，免得在这异界里翻了船。
虽然他来到这异界的身体，只是自身照映在青铜镜上的投影。
但是据青铜镜反馈来的信息，陆羽知道自己若是在这异界里受了伤，投影依然会反馈到他在帝国的身体上。
若是在异界里被敌人打死，本体虽然不会直接死亡，但也会直接灵魂虚弱很长一段时间。
青铜镜给他做这个投影，不是让陆羽来异界浪的，只是给陆羽一个保命的机会。
content_en:
"Guga!"
Among the ruined walls, Lu Yu's sudden appearance stirred up a crowd of crows.
Several of the black birds with scarlet eyes seemed to have smelled the living breath on Lu Yu.
His eyes glowed red, and he spread his black wings and rushed towards Lu Yu.
"Not strong, you can fight, but be careful with the numbers!"
As soon as he landed, Lu Yu, who was vigilantly observing his surroundings, immediately spotted the red-eyed black bird rushing towards him.
Lu Yu, who had been using the meditation method, had no fear in his heart, only the calmness and adrenaline surge of the upcoming battle.
Backing up a little, Lu Yu leaned against the broken wall and protected his back. Lu Yu waited patiently, waiting for the red-eyed black bird to fly closer.
"Wow!"
The sound of flapping wings approached in front of him, and the Red Sun Heart Lamp in Lu Yu's hand suddenly shone brightly.
"Eat a flashbang from me!"
"Buzz!"
The eyes of the red-eyed black bird that flew in front of Lu Yu were suddenly filled with white light, and it lost its vision. The red-eyed black bird immediately flew into chaos and became a mess.
What a great opportunity!
Seeing this, Lu Yu immediately seized the opportunity. An anti-riot stick appeared out of thin air in his other hand, and he whipped it at the red-eyed black bird in front of him.
There was a "click" sound.
This black bird with red eyes, which was the size of a hen, was suddenly splashed with blood, screamed wildly, and hit the ground, unable to stand up.
After knocking down a red-eyed black bird, Lu Yu gained the upper hand and continued to attack other red-eyed black birds.
Three strikes and five divided by two, Lu Yu easily killed four red-eyed black birds.
Seeing that their companion died tragically under Lu Yu's stick, the other red-eyed black birds around them immediately flapped their wings in panic and flew away from the ruined wall.
They were afraid that the black evil god in front of them would extend his claws to them again.
After the other red-eyed blackbirds dispersed, Lu Yu had no intention of expanding the victory and continued the pursuit.
He took a stick and poked at the corpses of four red-eyed blackbirds on the ground, crushing their heads and completely severing their lives.
After finishing, Lu Yu relaxed.
Even though Lu Yu was able to deal with these four red-eyed black birds neatly, he actually felt quite a bit of pressure during the actual battle.
The red-eyed blackbirds are only the size of a hen, but their speed and strength are more powerful than the eagles soaring in the sky in the empire, and they have the power of some monster beasts.
At least it is equivalent to a martial artist who has practiced boxing and kicking for several years.
They fall from the sky and can easily kill people in a sudden attack.
"Is this an ordinary creature from another world? This place looks a bit extraordinary!"
Ordinary birds in the other world are so powerful, Lu Yu raised the danger level of the other world in his mind to a higher level.
Lu Yu secretly told himself to be more careful, lest he capsize in this alien world.
Although his body in this other world is just a reflection of himself reflected on the bronze mirror.
But according to the information fed back by the bronze mirror, Lu Yu knew that if he was injured in this other world, the projection would still be reflected back to his body in the empire.
If you are killed by an enemy in another world, although your body will not die directly, your soul will be weakened for a long time.
The bronze mirror made this projection for him, not to let Lu Yu come to another world, but to give Lu Yu a chance to save his life.
